name: oracle-ai-data-platform-workbench-snowflake-migrator
description: SCAFFOLD (not functional): Snowflake -> Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP) migration toolkit. Forked verbatim from the Databricks migrator plugin v0.2.0 as the reuse base; the ~85% source-neutral AIDP-target machinery (OCI-signed REST + Jupyter WebSocket transport, cluster session/lifecycle, 429/circuit-breaker throttling, write-redirect data-safety sandbox, resume registry, retry orchestration, acceptance contract, JOB_REPORT reporting contract, FUSE hazard scanner) is intended for reuse; the ~15% Databricks source machinery (Unity Catalog extractor, dbutils shim, cell rewriters, dialect prompts) still needs replacing. See PORTING-STATUS.md for the per-file keep/adapt/rewrite disposition and the blocking unknowns. Do not run against a customer estate until PORTING-STATUS.md shows Phase A and Phase B complete.
